clauses.clause: Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.)
clauses.evidence: keywords +HASTE on cast; no variant attacks or taps the turn it entered. Packs goblin_smuggler_haste_1 PASSES (cast, attacks the same turn for 2) and goblin_smuggler_haste_2 PASSES (cast, then its {T} ability the same turn); against a draft without HASTE the attack is not offered and the activation is refused ('summoning sickness (CR 302.6) without haste').

clauses.clause: {T}: Another target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
clauses.evidence: Targeting is exercised: ability [0] target slot 1..1 of [you_bear, opp_flier, opp_bear] (power <= 2 only; the Smuggler itself excluded; you_giant, opp_tapped, opp_giant excluded); each [activate [0] targets=[X]]: card becomes tapped, X is targeted. The unblockability is never seen in combat: pack goblin_smuggler_unblockable_1 PASSES (your 2/2 attacks, the opponent's untapped 4/4 is never offered a block, 2 damage) and goblin_smuggler_unblockable_2 PASSES (on your next turn the 4/4 may block it). Drafts killed: restriction narrowed to flying blockers (pack 1), DurationPermanent (pack 2). Tree equals cardtool parse (template B3-target-cant-be-blocked).
